title: Pin web CI to the runner handoff digest
rationale: The web consumer uses a container image pinned by @sha256 rather than a mutable tag; the workflow comment and companion document point reviewers to NacoSolutions/senshac-runner PR #21 and its exported handoff.

title: Repair the web consumer after the published runner digest changed
rationale: The merged senshac-web handoff referenced an unavailable runner digest and failed with manifest unknown. The consumer must pin the digest actually published by successful workflow 35214744376, ghcr.io/nacosolutions/senshac-runner@sha256:681eb70b649ad6af34cc70b5abc1944276db015f17c73625423b3cbbc07421ab, while retaining immutable-reference contract checks.

title: Grant web CI token access to private GHCR runner
rationale: GitHub container jobs pull private GHCR images before job steps run, so the consumer workflow must declare top-level packages: read alongside contents: read. Keep the producer handoff image pinned to the immutable digest and use no secrets.

title: Consume the newly published runner digest
rationale: senshac-web CI must follow the runner handoff by pinning ghcr.io/nacosolutions/senshac-runner@sha256:a6579fc8e776f5a8c94f9f3287ad8864d17706445466992d8704fa9baf46bbfe in both the workflow and handoff documentation; retain packages: read for private GHCR pulls and the existing setup-node/npm contract.

title: Consume verified rootless runner digest in web CI
rationale: The web contract now uses the published senshac-runner digest from workflow 36323875728, authenticates private GHCR with packages: read and GITHUB_TOKEN, runs as UID/GID 1000, and derives PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH from the image's PATH-provided Chromium.

description: Web CI run 36324914218 created a failed push check suite with zero jobs because PR #99 pinned the unavailable senshac-runner digest ee7d648ca019f01cca3ddafccf8cef0ac525aa5948f7cbd8ecfa04590dcf4fb6. The workflow contract was restored to the published immutable digest 681eb70b649ad6af34cc70b5abc1944276db015f17c73625423b3cbbc07421ab; check-ci-parity also required a Bun-compatible js-yaml namespace import and explicit browser-smoke CI-only classification.
resolution: Updated .github/workflows/ci.yml and docs/ci-runner-image.md, made scripts/check-ci-parity.ts parse under Bun 1.3.13, and wired quality into verify:ci without removing browser smoke.
